verdict.rationale: Plausible documents HTTP APIs: a Stats API with a JSON /api/v2/query endpoint and an Events API. The question of a downloadable machine-readable spec therefore applies, but nothing in the pack mentions an OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and probes of the common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. Having HTTP APIs is not the same as publishing a machine-readable spec for them, so this earns no credit.
